album.description:
在破碎之后，慢慢找回平静；
直到某个清晨，冰无声地化开，
才发现沉默里的力量，一直带著自己向前 —— 缓慢，却从未停下。

《JJ20 FINAL LAP 世界巡回演唱会》落幕后，JJ林俊杰让自己停了下来，没有急著发表新作，而是花了一段时间休息，慢慢消化那些舞台之外，难以说出口的情绪。
「对我来说，这个标题捕捉的是一种安静的力量。」JJ林俊杰说，重新站起来的过程，很多时候发生在没有人看见的地方。就像冬天的河，表面看似静止，底下却从未停止流动。他也用三个关键字形容这首歌：「平静」，是重新听见自己内心的声音；「信念」，是在考验中依然坚守自己所爱；「重生」，是只留下生命中真正重要的，找到内心的那道光，然后重新出发。
〈RISE WITHOUT A SOUND〉是他从平静走到重生的全新创作，这首歌的副歌唱著：「We were always meant to rise without a sound.」而「We」这个字，是JJ林俊杰写给这些年一直陪在身边的人，也写给此刻正在经历困难的朋友们。
有些前进听不见声音，但当光照进来的那天，你会知道，自己一直都在路上。

When life leaves us in pieces, we slowly find our way back to stillness.
Then, one morning, the ice thaws without a sound, and we discover that the strength within the silence has been carrying us forward all along.
Slowly, yet never standing still.
At the close of the JJ20 FINAL LAP World Tour, JJ chose to pause. He gave himself time before his next release - to rest, and to slowly absorb the emotions beyond the stage that had been difficult to put into words.
“For me, the title captures a quiet kind of strength,” JJ says. The process of rising again often unfolds where no one can see. He likens it to a river in winter: seemingly still on the surface, yet never ceasing to flow beneath.
Three words define the song: stillness, belief, and rebirth. 
Stillness is hearing your inner voice again. 
Belief is staying true to what you love through times of uncertainty and trial. 
Rebirth is letting go of all but what truly matters, finding the light within, and beginning again.
With his new single, RISE WITHOUT A SOUND, JJ gives voice to that journey from stillness to rebirth. At its heart lies the chorus: “We were always meant to rise without a sound.” That “we” reaches beyond his own story — to those who have stood beside him through the years, and to anyone navigating a difficult chapter of their own.
Some steps forward make no sound. But when the light finally breaks through, you will know: you have been moving forward all along.
album.name: Rise Without A Sound
